title: Cognitia Republic — Episode 002 (V7) real-asset assembly + render
goal: Use Hermes reasoning (ChatGPT/local skills/vector/repo) to locate the real Episode-002 proof assets, place them into the V7 asset slots, run privacy/QC, render an all-real 10-12s preview, STOP for approval, then on approval render the 60s final and optionally deliver to Telegram.
operating_principle: Hermes decides which files map to which slot using reasoning + vectors + repo docs. The human is NOT asked to sort files unless an asset cannot be found anywhere reachable.
vector_sources: repo docs: hermes/episodes/ep002/STORYBOARD.md, DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, ASSET_REQUEST.md, REAL_CROPS_NEEDED.md

derive_shot.method: extract a representative frame, chest-up, top-anchored 4:5, do not distort identity
ffmpeg showwavespic waveform in brand cyan/blue

produce_if_missing.method: send final via Telegram if SEND_TELEGRAM=true + token + chat, then capture confirmation; otherwise leave PLACEHOLDER

search.vector_hint: vision QC result with brand / fake-AI / face_box scores

prior_episode_hint.note: reuse Episode 001 avatar/voice only if visually/contextually valid for Ep002; otherwise ignore

steps.desc: For each slot: if explicit env path set use it; else reason over search_locations + vectors to pick the best candidate; copy into target.
Derive heygen.png (chest-up 4:5) and elevenlabs.png (waveform) from the real avatar/voice.
Run privacy gate on every shot; abort if secrets visible.
COG_S=1 render animate.py; mux vo.mp3; write out/preview_real.mp4 + contact sheet.
Halt. Report which slots are real vs PLACEHOLDER. Wait for approval.
COG_S=${COG_FINAL_SCALE:2} render final_ep002.py; mux vo.mp3; write out/ep002_final.mp4.
sendDocument ep002_final.mp4; capture confirmation as telegram.png; otherwise skip.

deterministic_fallback: If no Hermes reasoning layer is present, the wrapper runs hermes/episodes/ep002/tools/run_local_ep002.sh (or .ps1), which performs resolve/derive/qc/render/approval deterministically.

result_states.A: Hermes assembled all-real (or mostly-real) assets and rendered the 10-12s preview; awaiting approval for 60s.
result_states.B: Hermes found candidates but needs ONE human decision (ambiguous slot or missing required avatar).
result_states.C: No Hermes/local bridge; deterministic runner used instead (this package is the handoff).
